_notes.profile_dir: Each account keeps its own Chrome profile (its logins). One profile can be logged into BOTH YouTube and TikTok.
_notes.chrome_binary_path: Leave empty to use the system-installed Chrome. Set a path only if you use a standalone Chrome.
_notes.video_save_dir: Folder holding the .mp4 files (relative to this folder or absolute). Each video may have a same-name .txt = {"title":"...","tags":["a","b"]} and optional same-name .jpg/.png thumbnail.
_notes.use_schedule: false = upload immediately one after another (good for testing). true = spread across the 06-09/11-14/17-23 windows.
_notes.max_uploads_per_day: Cap on how many videos this account uploads per run.
